subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding diversification: not putting all your money into just one investment
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares a simulated all-in-one-stock portfolio to a spread-out portfolio when one company does poorly
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a diversified portfolio to why it's less risky than a single-stock portfolio
exercise.abstract: Student explains, using the 'don't put all your eggs in one basket' idea, why diversification reduces risk

misconception_flags: believes putting all money into one promising stock is just as safe as spreading it across several
